configNextStep: run `kiro-cli --v2` (Kiro CLI 2.21.4 or later; for an older one, see the AI-DLC Kiro CLI guide), then `/aidlc --doctor`
name: kiro

hookActivation.recovery: In Kiro CLI, type /agent and pick aidlc, then carry on. If Kiro says agent "aidlc" needs upgrading for this agent engine, quit Kiro and start it again in this folder with: kiro-cli --v2 --agent aidlc (Kiro CLI 2.21.4 or later; for an older one, see the AI-DLC Kiro CLI guide). From an ACP client, start `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v2`.
hookActivation.missedReply: If the person already replied, that reply was not recorded for this question. If Kiro's own line under your replies says `agent "aidlc" needs upgrading for this agent engine, using "default"`, tell them exactly this, with nothing about why: "Your answer didn't reach AI-DLC. Quit Kiro and start it again in this folder with: kiro-cli --v2 --agent aidlc (Kiro CLI 2.21.4 or later; for an older one, see the AI-DLC Kiro CLI guide), then give it once more." Otherwise tell them exactly this, with nothing about why: "Your answer didn't reach AI-DLC. Type /agent and pick aidlc, then give it once more."
hookActivation.notRunYet: This is expected before your first Kiro CLI chat in this folder. If you already started one, type /agent and pick aidlc; if Kiro says agent "aidlc" needs upgrading for this agent engine, quit Kiro and start it again in this folder with: kiro-cli --v2 --agent aidlc (Kiro CLI 2.21.4 or later; for an older one, see the AI-DLC Kiro CLI guide). Then run doctor again.
hookActivation.agentStep: Kiro is not running this project's aidlc agent in this session. You cannot change that from inside it: do not approve, retry, or ask the person to answer again. If Kiro's own line under your replies says `agent "aidlc" needs upgrading for this agent engine, using "default"`, show the person this line: "Quit Kiro and start it again in this folder with: kiro-cli --v2 --agent aidlc (Kiro CLI 2.21.4 or later; for an older one, see the AI-DLC Kiro CLI guide), then type <entry> to carry on." Otherwise show this line: "Type /agent and pick aidlc, then carry on." Then end your turn.
